generic.Defined scope/population: All inward bordereaux received for the treaty and reporting period awaiting filing in the document repository.
generic.In-scope period: The treaty reporting period being archived, from period start date to period end date.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Treaty code, underwriting year, cedant name and period end date present on file name and record.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Count of archived files equals the count of bordereaux submissions registered for the period.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Original and normalized copies stored with upload timestamp and version in the repository.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Missing originals or covering receipts logged with an owner and a refile date.
generic.Test population: Every bordereau submission registered in the reinsurance administration system for the period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: 100 percent of submissions archived with a document link written back to the bordereau record.
generic.Exception handling path: Unarchived or misfiled submissions returned to the Bordereaux Analyst for refiling before close.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Original plus normalized copy plus covering receipt filed under treaty code, UW year and period.
generic.Evidence location: Document management repository treaty folder and the archive link on the bordereau record.

steps.title: Extract the received bordereaux list for the period from the reinsurance administration system
sop: Filter the submission register by reporting period and submission status received or loaded.
Export the list with treaty code, cedant, underwriting year, period end date and submission reference.
Done when the period submission list is exported and the record count is noted.
verify: Exported list covers every treaty with an expected submission in the period.
Pass when the exported record count matches the register count for the period.

steps.title: Assemble original, normalized and receipt files for each submission from the intake staging area
sop: Locate the cedant original file, the normalized internal copy and the covering email or portal receipt.
Confirm each set belongs to the same submission reference before packaging.
Done when a complete three-part file set exists for every submission on the list.
verify: Every submission reference has an original, a normalized copy and a receipt.
Pass when no submission on the list is short of any of the three files.

steps.title: Create the treaty folder path in the document management repository
sop: Build or open the path treaty code then underwriting year then reporting period.
Reuse the existing path where the treaty and year folders already exist rather than duplicating.
Done when a target folder exists for every submission being archived.
verify: Folder path segments read treaty code, underwriting year and reporting period in that order.
Pass when no duplicate treaty or underwriting year folder has been created.

steps.title: Name and upload the file sets into the document management repository
sop: Rename each file to carry cedant name, treaty reference and period end date.
Upload the original, the normalized copy and the receipt into the period folder.
Done when all three files per submission are uploaded under the agreed naming convention.
verify: File names include cedant, treaty reference and period end date with no free text variants.
Pass when every uploaded file carries a repository timestamp and version number.

steps.title: Write the archive document link back to the bordereau record in the reinsurance administration system
sop: Copy the repository link for the archived folder or file set.
Paste the link into the archive link field on the matching bordereau submission record.
Done when every submission record on the period list carries an archive link.
verify: Each link opens the correct treaty, underwriting year and period folder.
Pass when no submission record for the period has an empty archive link field.

steps.title: Reconcile archived file counts to the submission register and log exceptions
sop: Count archived file sets in the repository for the period and compare to the register count.
Log any missing original, normalized copy or receipt as an exception with an owner and refile date.
Done when the counts agree or every difference is logged as an exception.
verify: Reconciliation shows repository count, register count and any explained difference.
Pass when no unexplained difference remains between archive and register counts.

steps.title: Review and sign off the period archive completeness
sop: Review the reconciliation and the open exception list for the period.
Confirm exceptions have owners and dates before accepting the archive as complete.
Done when the archive completeness sign-off is recorded for the period.
verify: Sign-off names the reviewer, the period and the exception position at review date.
Pass when the period archive is signed off with no unowned exception.

generic.Defined scope/population: All open bordereaux validation exceptions requiring a query to the cedant or broker for the period.
generic.In-scope period: The bordereau reporting period whose exceptions are under query, until each query closes.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each query line carries treaty reference, field, record count, value impact and contact name.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Exception count on the query log equals the open exception count in the validation report.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Query emails, chasers and cedant responses attached to the query line with dates.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Every query closed as corrected, accepted, or escalated with the reason recorded.
generic.Test population: All exceptions raised against bordereaux for the period across every cedant queried.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No query open past the agreed turnaround without a recorded chaser.
generic.Exception handling path: Unanswered queries escalated to the Reinsurance Ops Manager for cedant relationship follow-up.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Query closes only after the corrected or resubmitted records revalidate clean.
generic.Evidence location: Query log in Microsoft Excel and the query record on the reinsurance administration system.

steps.title: Build the query log in Microsoft Excel from the open bordereaux exception list
sop: Pull open exceptions from the reinsurance administration system for the reporting period.
List each exception with treaty reference, field in error, record count and premium value impact.
Done when every open exception appears once on the query log.
verify: Query log line count equals the open exception count in the validation report.
Pass when no open exception is missing from the query log.

steps.title: Identify the named cedant or broker contact from the treaty contact list
sop: Open the treaty record and read the current bordereau and accounts contacts.
Confirm the contact is still current before use and correct the record if it is stale.
Done when each query line carries a named recipient and email address.
verify: Recipient on each query matches the treaty contact list, not a personal address book.
Pass when no query line lacks a named cedant or broker contact.

steps.title: Send the grouped query pack to the cedant by Microsoft Teams or Email
sop: Group query lines by cedant and treaty so each contact receives one consolidated pack.
State the response due date in line with the agreed query turnaround.
Done when a query pack has been sent for every cedant with open exceptions.
verify: Sent pack lists exceptions with counts, values and a stated response due date.
Pass when every cedant with open exceptions has a dated sent query.

steps.title: Issue chasers on the query log where the turnaround has lapsed
sop: Filter the query log for lines past the agreed response due date.
Send a chaser to the same contact and stamp the chase date on the query line.
Done when every overdue query carries a chaser with a date.
verify: Chase dates recorded against each overdue query line.
Pass when no query is overdue without a recorded chaser.

steps.title: Attach cedant responses and resubmitted bordereaux to the query line
sop: Save the cedant reply and any resubmitted file against the query line reference.
Record the response date and whether a corrected file was provided.
Done when every responded query has its reply and any file attached.
verify: Each responded query shows a reply document and a response date.
Pass when no responded query lacks its supporting attachment.

steps.title: Revalidate corrected records and close the query in the reinsurance administration system
sop: Rerun validation over the corrected or resubmitted records for the treaty and period.
Close the query only where the records now pass and record the closure reason.
Done when every resolved query is closed with a clean revalidation result.
verify: Closed queries show a clean revalidation run reference and closure reason.
Pass when no query is closed while its records still fail validation.

steps.title: Escalate unresolved cedant queries to the Reinsurance Ops Manager
sop: Review queries still open after the chaser cycle with their age and value impact.
Agree the escalation route to the cedant relationship owner and record the action.
Done when every aged unresolved query has an escalation action recorded.
verify: Escalation record shows query age, value impact and the agreed action.
Pass when no aged unresolved query is left without escalation.

generic.Defined scope/population: All treaties flagged late or missing that have passed the contractual reporting grace period.
generic.In-scope period: The overdue reporting periods for each flagged treaty up to the current reporting cut-off.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Treaty, cedant, missing period and days past due populated on every escalation line.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Escalated treaty count equals the count of flags past the grace period on the late report.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Escalation message and prior chasers stored with send dates against the treaty.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Treaties not escalated are logged with the reason such as agreed extension.
generic.Test population: Every late or missing bordereau flag raised for the reporting cut-off.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Every flag past the grace period carries an escalation with a manager acknowledgement.
generic.Exception handling path: Non-acknowledged escalations re-sent and raised at the reinsurance operations review.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Escalated items remain on the late-bordereaux report until the submission is received.
generic.Evidence location: Escalation thread in Microsoft Teams or Email and the flag record in the reinsurance administration system.

steps.title: Extract flags past the grace period from the late-bordereaux report
sop: Open the late and missing bordereaux report in the reinsurance administration system.
Filter to flags where days past the contractual due date exceed the treaty grace period.
Done when the escalation candidate list is produced for the cut-off.
verify: Candidate list shows treaty, cedant, missing period and days past due.
Pass when every flag past the grace period appears on the candidate list.

steps.title: Gather prior chaser evidence for each candidate treaty
sop: Collect chaser emails sent to the cedant for the overdue period with their send dates.
Note any cedant response promising a submission date.
Done when each candidate treaty has its chaser history assembled.
verify: Chaser history shows dates and recipients for each escalation candidate.
Pass when no candidate is escalated without evidence of prior follow-up.

steps.title: Draft the escalation message naming treaty, cedant, period and days overdue
sop: State the treaty reference, cedant, missing reporting period and days past the due date.
Attach the chaser history and note the accounting impact of the missing submission.
Done when the escalation draft is complete for every candidate treaty.
verify: Draft names treaty reference and overdue period explicitly.
Pass when no draft omits the days past due or the chaser evidence.

steps.title: Send the escalation to the treaty manager via Microsoft Teams or Email
sop: Send the escalation to the Reinsurance Manager responsible for the treaty.
Record the escalation date on the flag record in the reinsurance administration system.
Done when every candidate treaty escalation is sent and dated.
verify: Escalation date recorded against each flagged treaty period.
Pass when every candidate on the list has a sent escalation.

steps.title: Record the treaty manager acknowledgement against the flag
sop: Acknowledge receipt of the escalation and state the intended follow-up with the cedant.
Have the acknowledgement date captured on the flag record.
Done when every escalation carries a dated manager acknowledgement.
verify: Acknowledgement shows manager name, date and intended follow-up action.
Pass when no escalated treaty is left without an acknowledgement.

steps.title: Keep escalated items on the late-bordereaux report until submission is received
sop: Retain the escalated flag on the report at each subsequent cut-off.
Clear the flag only when the matching bordereau is ingested and loaded.
Done when the escalated list reflects only genuinely outstanding submissions.
verify: Cleared items each tie to an ingested bordereau submission reference.
Pass when no escalated item is cleared without a received submission.

generic.Defined scope/population: All in-force treaties with an expected bordereau submission at the current reporting cut-off.
generic.In-scope period: Reporting periods due under each treaty reporting frequency up to the cut-off date.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Treaty reference, reporting frequency, due date and submission status present for each expected period.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Expected submission count equals received plus late plus missing counts for the cut-off.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Flag list saved with refresh timestamp at each reporting cut-off.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Treaties with agreed reporting extensions logged so they are not flagged in error.
generic.Test population: Every treaty period with a due date on or before the reporting cut-off.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Every past-due treaty period carries a late or missing flag with no false positives.
generic.Exception handling path: Disputed flags referred to the Treaty Specialist to confirm the contractual due date.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Partial submissions flagged separately from wholly missing ones and flags auto-clear on ingest.
generic.Evidence location: Expected-submission calendar in Microsoft Excel and flag status in the reinsurance administration system.

steps.title: Build the expected-submission calendar in Microsoft Excel from treaty reporting terms
sop: Extract reporting frequency and due-date rules for every in-force treaty.
Generate the expected submission periods and due dates through the current cut-off.
Done when every in-force treaty has its expected periods listed with due dates.
verify: Calendar frequency and due dates match the treaty reporting clause.
Pass when no in-force treaty is absent from the expected-submission calendar.

steps.title: Match received submissions in the reinsurance administration system to expected periods
sop: Pull submissions received to date with treaty, period and submission reference.
Match each submission to its expected calendar row on treaty and reporting period.
Done when every received submission is matched to an expected period.
verify: Unmatched received submissions investigated rather than ignored.
Pass when received plus outstanding equals the expected submission count.

steps.title: Flag past-due periods with no submission as missing
sop: Select expected periods with a due date passed and no matched submission.
Set the missing flag on the treaty period record with the days past due.
Done when every wholly unreported past-due period carries a missing flag.
verify: Missing flags carry treaty, period and days past due.
Pass when no past-due unreported period is left unflagged.

steps.title: Flag partial submissions separately from wholly missing ones
sop: Identify submissions received without all treaty sections or with incomplete coverage.
Apply the partial flag and note which sections remain outstanding.
Done when every incomplete submission carries a partial flag with the gap described.
verify: Partial and missing flags are distinguishable on the report.
Pass when no partial submission is reported as fully received.

steps.title: Refresh the flag list at the reporting cut-off before the accounting close
sop: Rerun the match and flag routine at the cut-off date.
Save the refreshed list with the run timestamp for the close pack.
Done when the flag list is refreshed and timestamped for the close.
verify: Saved list carries the cut-off date and run timestamp.
Pass when the flag list in the close pack is the cut-off refresh, not an earlier run.

steps.title: Confirm contractual due dates on disputed flags with the Treaty Specialist
sop: Review flags the cedant disputes against the treaty reporting clause and any agreed extension.
Correct the calendar due date or uphold the flag and record the decision.
Done when every disputed flag has a documented due-date decision.
verify: Decision cites the treaty reporting clause or the agreed extension.
Pass when no received and loaded bordereau remains flagged late.

generic.Defined scope/population: All inward bordereaux submissions arriving from cedants and brokers for the reporting period.
generic.In-scope period: The treaty reporting period stated on the covering statement of each submission.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Treaty, cedant, reporting period, row count and premium control total captured at intake.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Ingested row count and premium total equal the covering statement figures.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Submission file and receipt acknowledgement stored with intake timestamp and submission reference.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Format or template breaches logged at intake with a return-to-cedant or accept decision.
generic.Test population: Every file received through Reinsurer Exchange or by direct cedant delivery in the period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No ingested submission lacks a matched treaty, reporting period and submission reference.
generic.Exception handling path: Unmatched or off-template submissions quarantined and queried before any transformation.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Layout matches the treaty-agreed bordereau template and receipt is acknowledged same day.
generic.Evidence location: Submission register in the reinsurance administration system and the file in the document management repository.

steps.title: Collect inward bordereaux submissions from Reinsurer Exchange and cedant delivery channels
sop: Check Reinsurer Exchange and the agreed delivery mailbox for new cedant submissions.
Download each file with its covering statement into the intake staging area.
Done when all newly arrived submissions are collected into staging.
verify: Every collected file has its covering statement alongside it.
Pass when no submission sits unretrieved in the delivery channel.

steps.title: Match each submission to the expected treaty, cedant and reporting period
sop: Read treaty reference, cedant and period from the covering statement and file header.
Match to the expected-submission calendar row in the reinsurance administration system.
Done when every submission is matched to one expected treaty period.
verify: Matched treaty, cedant and period recorded on the intake record.
Pass when no submission is ingested without a matched treaty and reporting period.

steps.title: Check file format and layout against the treaty-agreed bordereau template
sop: Compare column headings, order and data types to the treaty template.
Quarantine files that deviate from the template and raise a format exception.
Done when every submission is confirmed on template or quarantined.
verify: Template version used for the check is recorded on the intake record.
Pass when no off-template file passes intake without a logged exception.

steps.title: Capture row count and premium control total from the covering statement
sop: Read the stated row count and premium total from the cedant covering statement.
Compare to the actual file row count and premium sum and note any difference.
Done when both stated and actual control figures are recorded at intake.
verify: Intake record shows stated and actual row count and premium total.
Pass when any difference between stated and actual totals is logged as an exception.

steps.title: Register the submission with a unique reference in the reinsurance administration system
sop: Create the submission record with treaty, cedant, period, counts and control totals.
Allocate the unique submission reference before any transformation begins.
Done when every collected file carries a registered submission reference.
verify: Submission reference is unique and linked to the stored file.
Pass when no file enters normalization without a registered submission reference.

steps.title: Send the receipt acknowledgement to the cedant or broker on the day of receipt
sop: Acknowledge receipt quoting the submission reference, treaty and period.
File the acknowledgement in the document management repository with the submission.
Done when every submission received today has a sent acknowledgement.
verify: Acknowledgement date equals the receipt date for each submission.
Pass when no submission is left unacknowledged at the end of the receipt day.

generic.Defined scope/population: All validated bordereau records staged for load into the reinsurance administration system.
generic.In-scope period: The bordereau reporting period and its underwriting year being loaded.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Treaty, section, underwriting year and mapped risk and premium fields valid on every staged row.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Loaded record count and premium total equal the validated staging figures and covering statement.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Load reference and timestamp stamped on each loaded risk and premium record.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Rejected rows written to a reject file and requeued as exceptions with an owner.
generic.Test population: All staged rows presented to the load for the treaty and reporting period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Load status complete with record count and premium control total matching to the penny.
generic.Exception handling path: Failed loads rolled back and rerun after correction rather than partially patched.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: No records loaded under an incorrect treaty section or underwriting year.
generic.Evidence location: Load log and reject file in the reinsurance administration system with the staging workbook.

steps.title: Confirm the staging file has passed validation before load
sop: Check the validation run status and the open blocking exception count for the submission.
Hold the load where blocking exceptions remain unresolved.
Done when the staging file is confirmed validated with no blocking exceptions.
verify: Validation run reference and date recorded against the submission.
Pass when no blocking exception remains open on the file being loaded.

steps.title: Select the target treaty, section and underwriting year in the reinsurance administration system
sop: Open the load configuration and select the treaty reference, section and underwriting year.
Cross-check the selection against the submission record before running.
Done when the load target is set and confirmed against the submission.
verify: Load target matches the treaty, section and underwriting year on the submission record.
Pass when no load is queued against a mismatched treaty section.

steps.title: Record pre-load control totals from the staging workbook in Microsoft Excel
sop: Capture validated record count, premium total and sum insured total from staging.
Save the control sheet with the submission reference for post-load comparison.
Done when pre-load control totals are recorded and saved.
verify: Control sheet cites the submission reference and staging file name.
Pass when pre-load totals agree to the cedant covering statement.

steps.title: Execute the load into Sapiens ReinsurancePro through the administration system interface
sop: Run the load job for the selected treaty section and underwriting year.
Monitor the job to completion and capture the load reference and timestamp.
Done when the load job finishes with a completed status and a load reference.
verify: Load reference and timestamp stamped on the loaded records.
Pass when the load status is complete rather than partial or failed.

steps.title: Reconcile loaded counts and premium totals to the pre-load control sheet
sop: Extract loaded record count, premium and sum insured totals for the load reference.
Compare to the pre-load control sheet and to the covering statement.
Done when loaded totals agree to the control sheet or the difference is explained.
verify: Reconciliation shows staged, loaded and statement totals side by side.
Pass when loaded record count and premium control total match the validated staging figures.

steps.title: Write rejected rows to the reject file and requeue them as exceptions
sop: Export rows rejected by the load with the rejection reason per row.
Raise each rejection as an exception with an owner and target resolution date.
Done when every rejected row is captured as an owned exception.
verify: Reject file row count plus loaded row count equals the staged row count.
Pass when no rejected row is left outside the exception queue.

generic.Defined scope/population: All rows in the received bordereau failing a field-level or classification validation rule.
generic.In-scope period: The bordereau reporting period under validation for the treaty and underwriting year.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each exception carries row reference, field, rejected value, rule breached and severity.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Exception counts and premium impact totalled by treaty agree to the validation run output.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Validation run output saved with rule set version and run timestamp.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Every exception tagged blocking or non-blocking with the onward disposition recorded.
generic.Test population: Every row in the submission tested against the full bordereau rule set.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: 100 percent of failing rows appear on the exception log with a severity tag.
generic.Exception handling path: Blocking exceptions stop the load while non-blocking rows proceed and are queried separately.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Missing mandatory fields, invalid codes and duplicate policy references all captured.
generic.Evidence location: Exception log in the reinsurance administration system and the summary workbook in Microsoft Excel.

steps.title: Run the mandatory field check over the submission in the reinsurance administration system
sop: Test policy reference, inception date, expiry date and sum insured for population on every row.
List each failing row with the missing field name.
Done when every row missing a mandatory field is listed.
verify: Each listed row cites the specific missing field.
Pass when no row with an empty mandatory field is absent from the list.

steps.title: Test risk classification, currency and territory codes against the reference lists
sop: Compare reported class, currency and territory codes to the valid code lists.
Log every rejected value with the row reference and the code list checked.
Done when all invalid code values are logged with their rejected value.
verify: Logged exceptions show the rejected value, not just the field name.
Pass when no invalid code value passes the run unlogged.

steps.title: Identify duplicate policy references within the submission using Microsoft Excel
sop: Group rows by policy reference and inception date to surface repeats.
Log each duplicate group with the row references and the premium at stake.
Done when all duplicate policy references within the submission are logged.
verify: Duplicate log shows every row reference in each duplicate group.
Pass when no repeated policy reference remains unlogged.

steps.title: Tag each exception blocking or non-blocking
sop: Apply the agreed severity rules so structural and financial errors are blocking.
Tag presentational or non-financial gaps as non-blocking so clean rows can load.
Done when every logged exception carries a severity tag.
verify: Severity tag present on every exception line.
Pass when no exception is left untagged before the load decision.

steps.title: Summarize exception counts and premium impact by treaty for the query pack
sop: Total exception counts and affected premium by treaty and exception type.
Save the summary alongside the detailed log for the cedant query.
Done when the by-treaty summary is produced and saved.
verify: Summary totals agree to the detailed exception log.
Pass when exception count and premium impact are totalled by treaty.

steps.title: Record the validation run reference and rule set version on the submission
sop: Capture the run identifier, rule set version and run timestamp.
Write them to the submission record so the exception set is reproducible.
Done when the run reference and rule set version are recorded.
verify: Submission record shows run reference, rule set version and timestamp.
Pass when the logged exceptions can be traced to a named validation run.

generic.Defined scope/population: All ingested bordereau rows for the submission requiring mapping into the internal field set.
generic.In-scope period: The submission reporting period and underwriting year being transformed.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Internal field set populated with valid dates, currencies and line-of-business codes on every row.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Post-transformation premium total equals the pre-transformation premium total.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Mapping profile name, version and run date saved with the transformed staging file.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Unmapped class, currency or territory codes logged with a mapping or query disposition.
generic.Test population: Every row of the ingested submission passed through the mapping profile.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Zero unmapped class-of-business or currency codes remain in staging after the run.
generic.Exception handling path: Unmapped values referred for mapping profile update or raised as a cedant query.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Derived our-share premium calculated from the treaty participation percentage on every row.
generic.Evidence location: Transformed staging file and mapping profile record in the reinsurance administration system.

steps.title: Load the treaty mapping profile in the reinsurance administration system
sop: Open the mapping profile registered for the treaty and cedant template.
Confirm the profile version is current for the reporting period.
Done when the correct mapping profile is loaded and its version noted.
verify: Profile name, version and effective date recorded on the run.
Pass when the profile in use is the one registered for that treaty.

steps.title: Map cedant column headings to the internal bordereau field set
sop: Apply the profile so each cedant column lands on its internal field.
List any cedant column with no internal target for review.
Done when every required internal field is sourced from a cedant column.
verify: Unmapped cedant columns listed rather than silently dropped.
Pass when no required internal field is left unsourced.

steps.title: Convert currency, date and decimal formats to internal standards in Microsoft Excel staging
sop: Convert dates to the internal date format and decimals to the internal precision.
Standardize currency codes to ISO values used internally.
Done when all date, decimal and currency formats meet internal standards.
verify: Sample rows show converted formats identical to the internal standard.
Pass when no date or numeric field fails internal format parsing.

steps.title: Translate cedant class-of-business codes to the internal line-of-business hierarchy
sop: Apply the class translation table from the mapping profile to each row.
Log rows whose cedant class has no internal equivalent as unmapped exceptions.
Done when every row carries an internal line-of-business code or an unmapped exception.
verify: Unmapped class values logged with the rejected code and row count.
Pass when no unmapped class-of-business code remains in staging.

steps.title: Calculate derived fields including our share premium from the treaty participation percentage
sop: Read the treaty participation percentage for the section and underwriting year.
Apply it to reported premium and sum insured to derive our share values.
Done when derived our-share fields are populated on every row.
verify: Participation percentage used matches the treaty record for the section.
Pass when derived our-share premium recomputes correctly on a sampled row.

steps.title: Reconcile post-transformation totals to pre-transformation totals
sop: Sum premium and record counts before and after the transformation run.
Investigate any difference before releasing the file to validation.
Done when post-transformation totals equal pre-transformation totals.
verify: Comparison sheet shows both totals and a nil difference.
Pass when premium total is unchanged by the transformation.

steps.title: Publish the normalized dataset to the enterprise data warehouse or lakehouse
sop: Write the normalized staging set to the warehouse landing area with the submission reference.
Record the load timestamp and row count on the submission record.
Done when the normalized dataset is published with its row count recorded.
verify: Warehouse row count equals the normalized staging row count.
Pass when the published dataset carries the submission reference and timestamp.

generic.Defined scope/population: All validated and loaded bordereau premium and commission records awaiting ledger posting.
generic.In-scope period: The accounting period and underwriting year to which the bordereau data is posted.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Treaty, underwriting year, accounting period and ledger account valid on every posting line.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Ledger posting total equals the loaded bordereau premium control total for the period.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Posting batch reference and timestamp recorded against the bordereau submission record.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Suspended or failed postings logged with cause and a rework disposition.
generic.Test population: Every loaded bordereau submission for the period presented to the posting run.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Posted batch total equals the bordereau control total with no residual suspense balance.
generic.Exception handling path: Failed postings corrected at source and reposted rather than manually journalled around.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Premium, commission and brokerage split to their designated ledger accounts.
generic.Evidence location: Posting batch in the ERP general ledger and the batch reference on the submission record.

steps.title: Select loaded bordereau submissions ready for posting in the reinsurance administration system
sop: Filter submissions with load status complete and no open blocking exception.
Confirm the accounting period is open for each selected submission.
Done when the posting selection list is agreed for the period.
verify: Selection excludes submissions with open blocking exceptions.
Pass when every selected submission belongs to an open accounting period.

steps.title: Confirm treaty, underwriting year and accounting period coding on the posting set
sop: Check the treaty reference, underwriting year and period on each posting line.
Correct coding at source in the administration system where it is wrong.
Done when all posting lines carry correct treaty, year and period coding.
verify: Coding on a sample of lines matches the source submission record.
Pass when no posting line carries a treaty or underwriting year mismatch.

steps.title: Confirm the premium, commission and brokerage account split in the posting rules
sop: Review the posting rule mapping to premium, ceding commission and brokerage accounts.
Confirm no element is netted into another account.
Done when each element maps to its own designated ledger account.
verify: Mapping shows separate accounts for premium, commission and brokerage.

generic.Defined scope/population: All treaties with both a loaded bordereau and a cedant statement of account for the period.

steps.title: Extract bordereau premium and commission totals from the reinsurance administration system

steps.title: Capture the cedant statement of account totals for the same period

verify: Captured totals traceable to the statement document reference.

steps.title: Compare bordereau to statement line by line in Microsoft Excel

steps.title: Separate timing differences from true errors

steps.title: Quantify foreign exchange differences at the statement rate

verify: Rate used is the documented statement rate for the period.

steps.title: Raise residual unexplained variances as cedant queries with a due date
sop: List variances left after timing, error and exchange explanations with their value.
Raise each as a query to the cedant with an owner and a due date.

verify: Each query shows treaty, value, owner and due date.

steps.title: File the completed reconciliation against the period close checklist
sop: Review the reconciliation for completeness and explanation quality.

generic.Defined scope/population: All normalized bordereau risk and premium records staged for the treaty and reporting period.

generic.Defined scope/population: All in-force assumed treaties with written premium requiring an earned and unearned split for the period.

steps.title: Extract written premium by treaty and underwriting year from the reinsurance administration system

sop: Attach the premium and commission calculation workbook to the journal.

File the minutes with the review pack for the quarter.
Done when minutes and actions are distributed and filed.
verify: Action owners have received their actions in writing.
Pass when minutes are filed with the review pack for the quarter.

generic.Defined scope/population: The quarterly reserve position requiring formal actuarial sign-off before ledger posting.
generic.In-scope period: The valuation date and quarter to which the approved reserve position relates.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Valuation date, approved position, approver name and sign-off date populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Approved position on the sign-off equals the reserve schedule presented at the review.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Signed record dated and linked to the archived review pack version.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Qualifications, reliances and data limitations recorded on the sign-off itself.
generic.Test population: Every entity and valuation date requiring a quarterly reserve sign-off.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No reserve posted for the quarter ahead of the recorded sign-off date.
generic.Exception handling path: Unsigned positions block posting until the sign-off is obtained.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Method changes approved in the quarter listed on the sign-off record.
generic.Evidence location: Signed sign-off in the document management repository linked to the review pack.

steps.title: Draft the sign-off stating the valuation date and reserve position being approved
sop: State the valuation date, entity and the reserve position by class being approved.
Confirm the figures match the minuted review position.
Done when the sign-off draft states the valuation date and approved position.
verify: Draft figures equal the minuted agreed position.
Pass when the sign-off names the valuation date and the position approved.

steps.title: Record qualifications, reliances and data limitations on the sign-off
sop: List any reliance on cedant data, known limitations and qualifications.
Ensure each is specific rather than a generic disclaimer.
Done when all qualifications and reliances are recorded.
verify: Qualifications name the specific data or assumption relied on.
Pass when no known limitation is omitted from the sign-off.

steps.title: List method changes approved in the quarter on the sign-off record
sop: Add each method or assumption change approved at the review.
Show the quantified effect alongside each change.
Done when all approved method changes are listed with their effects.
verify: Listed changes match those tabled and agreed at the review.
Pass when no approved method change is absent from the sign-off.

steps.title: Obtain the signature and date the sign-off record
sop: Review the sign-off content against the minuted position before signing.
Sign and date the record in Microsoft Excel or the approved template.
Done when the sign-off carries a signature and a date.
verify: Signed record names the approver and the signing date.
Pass when a dated sign-off exists naming approver, valuation date and position.

steps.title: Capture the sign-off before reserve postings are released
sop: Confirm the sign-off date precedes the reserve posting date.
Notify the accountant that posting may proceed.
Done when the sign-off is captured ahead of the posting release.
verify: Sign-off date compared to the reserve posting date.
Pass when no reserve is posted for the quarter ahead of the sign-off date.

steps.title: Link the signed record to the archived reserve review pack
sop: File the signed record in the quarter folder in the document repository.
Link it from the reserve review record so the pair is retrievable.
Done when the signed record is filed and linked to the pack.
verify: Link opens the signed record from the review record.
Pass when the signed sign-off and the pack are retrievable together.

generic.Defined scope/population: All treaties whose incurred development exceeds the agreed adverse development threshold.
generic.In-scope period: The review quarter with movement measured since the prior reserve review.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Treaty, loss ratio movement, incurred development, remaining exposure and threshold populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Escalated treaty count equals the count flagged adverse in the development analysis.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Escalation message and supporting analysis stored with the send date against the treaty.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Treaties held back from escalation logged with the reason and a review date.
generic.Test population: Every treaty flagged adverse in the quarterly development analysis.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Management response recorded against each escalated treaty.
generic.Exception handling path: Non-responses re-raised at the underwriting review with the treaty owner.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Renewal implications and requested pricing or terms actions stated in the escalation.
generic.Evidence location: Escalation thread in Microsoft Teams or Email with the response on the treaty record.

steps.title: Pull the adverse development treaty list from the quarterly analysis
sop: Take the treaties flagged where development exceeds the adverse threshold.
Confirm the flag basis and the threshold applied.
Done when the escalation candidate list is fixed for the quarter.
verify: Candidate list matches the flagged treaties in the analysis.
Pass when every flagged treaty appears on the escalation list.

steps.title: Assemble loss ratio movement, incurred development and remaining exposure per treaty
sop: Extract loss ratio movement and incurred development from the reinsurance administration system.
Add remaining exposure and unexpired risk for the treaty.
Done when each escalation line carries all three measures.
verify: Measures reconcile to the reserve review analysis.
Pass when every escalated treaty shows loss ratio movement and threshold breached.

steps.title: Build the escalation view in Power BI for underwriting management
sop: Publish the adverse development view filtered to the escalation candidates.
Confirm the visuals reconcile to the underlying analysis.
Done when the escalation view is published and reconciled.
verify: Dashboard figures equal the assembled analysis figures.
Pass when the published view covers every escalated treaty.

steps.title: State renewal implications and requested pricing or terms actions
sop: Set out the renewal date and the implication of the development for each treaty.
State the pricing, terms or exposure action being requested.
Done when every escalation line states an implication and a requested action.
verify: Requested actions are specific rather than general concerns.
Pass when no escalation is issued without a requested action.

steps.title: Send the escalation to underwriting management and the treaty underwriter
sop: Address the escalation to underwriting management and the named treaty underwriter.
Attach the analysis and record the send date on the treaty record.
Done when the escalation is sent and dated for every candidate treaty.
verify: Recipients include the named treaty underwriter.
Pass when every escalated treaty carries a recorded send date.

steps.title: Record the management response and agreed action against the treaty
sop: Provide the management response and the agreed action for each treaty.
Have the response recorded on the treaty record with a date.
Done when every escalated treaty carries a recorded management response.
verify: Response records the decision and any action owner.
Pass when management response is recorded against each escalated treaty.

generic.Defined scope/population: All treaty classes requiring an IBNR estimate for unreported cedant losses at the valuation date.
generic.In-scope period: Underwriting and accident years with unexpired development at the valuation date.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Treaty class, method, development factors, expected loss ratio and prior IBNR populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: IBNR by class totals to the aggregate indication presented at the reserve review.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Method, factor selections and workbook version saved with the valuation date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Classes with insufficient data logged with the fallback method applied.
generic.Test population: Every treaty class carrying exposure at the valuation date.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Method and selected development factors documented for every treaty class.
generic.Exception handling path: Unexplained quarter on quarter movements investigated before the indication is issued.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Pure IBNR split from IBNER so late-reported cedant claims are visible separately.
generic.Evidence location: IBNR workbook in Microsoft Excel with triangles from the enterprise data warehouse.

steps.title: Select development factors by treaty class from the paid and incurred triangles
sop: Review the age to age factors from the triangles for each treaty class.
Select factors and record the basis such as volume weighted average.
Done when factors are selected and documented for every class.
verify: Selection basis documented for each class.
Pass when no class uses an undocumented development factor.

steps.title: Choose and document the method per treaty class
sop: Choose chain ladder, Bornhuetter-Ferguson or expected loss ratio per class.
Record the rationale for the choice given the data maturity.
Done when each class carries a documented method choice.
verify: Method documented with rationale for every class.
Pass when method and selected factors are documented per treaty class.

steps.title: Reconcile expected loss ratios to pricing and prior reserve assumptions
sop: Compare the expected loss ratios used to pricing and prior quarter assumptions.
Document and justify any change in the assumed loss ratio.
Done when expected loss ratios are reconciled and changes justified.
verify: Comparison shows pricing, prior and current expected loss ratios.
Pass when no change in expected loss ratio is unexplained.

steps.title: Calculate the IBNR indication by treaty class in Microsoft Excel
sop: Apply the selected method and factors to derive ultimate and IBNR by class.
Deduct paid and case reserves to arrive at the IBNR indication.
Done when the IBNR indication is calculated for every class.
verify: Indication recalculates from the documented method and factors.
Pass when every class in scope carries an IBNR indication.

steps.title: Split pure IBNR from IBNER
sop: Estimate the unreported claim component separately from development on known claims.
Present both components by treaty class.
Done when the IBNR indication is split into pure IBNR and IBNER.
verify: Both components shown and summing to the total indication.
Pass when late-reported cedant claims are visible as a separate component.

steps.title: Compare IBNR by class to the prior quarter and explain movements
sop: Set current IBNR against the prior quarter position by class.
Explain each movement by driver such as factor change or experience.
Done when every class movement carries an explanation.
verify: Explanations name a driver for each movement.
Pass when quarter on quarter IBNR movement is explained by class.

generic.Defined scope/population: All assumed treaties with incurred movement measured against expected development for the quarter.
generic.In-scope period: The quarter since the prior reserve review across all open underwriting years.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Treaty, underwriting year, actual and expected development, variance and driver populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Treaty level development sums to the class level movement in the reserve analysis.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Analysis workbook saved with valuation date, threshold used and version.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Treaties with data gaps logged and excluded from flagging with a reason.
generic.Test population: Every treaty with an open reserve at the valuation date.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Treaties flagged wherever development exceeds the defined adverse threshold.
generic.Exception handling path: Flagged treaties carried into the quarterly reserve review agenda for discussion.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Each flagged treaty carries the quantified variance and its driver.
generic.Evidence location: Development analysis workbook in Microsoft Excel published to Power BI.

steps.title: Extract incurred development by treaty and underwriting year from the enterprise data warehouse
sop: Query incurred movement for the quarter by treaty and underwriting year.
Record the valuation date and record count for the extract.
Done when the incurred development extract is produced.
verify: Extract covers every treaty with an open reserve.
Pass when extract totals reconcile to the reserve movement for the quarter.

steps.title: Compute expected development from the selected development factors
sop: Apply the current development factors to the opening position by treaty.
Produce the expected incurred movement for the quarter.
Done when expected development is computed for every treaty.
verify: Factors used are the current selected factors for the class.
Pass when every treaty has an expected development figure.

steps.title: Compare actual to expected development and quantify the variance
sop: Calculate actual less expected development per treaty and underwriting year.
Express the variance in value and as a percentage of expected.
Done when every treaty carries a quantified variance.
verify: Variance shown in both value and percentage terms.
Pass when no treaty is left without an actual versus expected comparison.

steps.title: Flag treaties breaching the adverse development threshold
sop: Apply the defined adverse threshold to the variance results.
Flag breaching treaties and record the threshold applied.
Done when all breaching treaties are flagged.
verify: Threshold applied is the currently defined adverse threshold.
Pass when treaties are flagged wherever development exceeds the threshold.

steps.title: Show loss ratio movement since the prior review per treaty
sop: Calculate the loss ratio at the prior and current valuation per treaty.
Present the movement alongside the development variance.
Done when loss ratio movement is shown for every flagged treaty.
verify: Loss ratios recompute from incurred and earned premium.
Pass when every flagged treaty shows its loss ratio movement.

steps.title: Identify single large or event losses driving the movement
sop: Decompose the movement into large loss, event loss and attritional components.
Name the driver for each flagged treaty.
Done when every flagged treaty carries a named driver.
verify: Driver components sum to the total movement.
Pass when each flagged treaty carries the quantified variance and driver.

steps.title: Carry the flagged treaties into the quarterly reserve review agenda
sop: Add the flagged treaties with drivers to the review agenda pack.
Publish the supporting view to Power BI for the meeting.
Done when flagged treaties appear on the reserve review agenda.
verify: Agenda list matches the flagged treaty list.
Pass when no flagged treaty is omitted from the review agenda.

generic.Defined scope/population: All actuarial IBNR indications by class to be reflected in the assumed claims reserve postings.
generic.In-scope period: The valuation date and the accounting period into which the indication is booked.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Actuarial class, mapped treaty, ledger reserve account and indicated IBNR populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Booked IBNR total agrees to the signed actuarial indication for the valuation date.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Mapping and booking workbook saved with the indication version and valuation date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Differences between indication and booked amount documented and approved.
generic.Test population: Every actuarial class carrying an IBNR indication at the valuation date.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No actuarial class left unmapped to a ledger reserve account.
generic.Exception handling path: Unmapped classes referred back before booking rather than posted to a default account.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Existing IBNR balance adjusted to the indicated position rather than added to it.
generic.Evidence location: Mapping workbook in Microsoft Excel and posted balances in the ERP general ledger.

steps.title: Receive the signed actuarial IBNR indication for the valuation date
sop: Provide the signed indication by actuarial class with the valuation date.
Confirm the version supplied is the approved one.
Done when the signed indication is received and its version recorded.
verify: Indication carries a signature and a valuation date.
Pass when the version booked is the signed approved version.

steps.title: Map actuarial classes to treaties and ledger reserve accounts
sop: Apply the class to treaty and account mapping table.
List any actuarial class with no mapped ledger account.
Done when every actuarial class is mapped or listed as unmapped.
verify: Mapping table version recorded with the run.
Pass when no actuarial class is left unmapped to a ledger reserve account.

steps.title: Exclude case reserves from the IBNR figure to avoid double counting
sop: Confirm the indication is net of case reserves for each class.
Adjust where the indication is presented on an ultimate basis.
Done when the IBNR figure to be booked excludes case reserves.
verify: Case reserve deduction evidenced in the workbook.
Pass when booked IBNR contains no case reserve element.

steps.title: Adjust the existing IBNR balance to the indicated position
sop: Compare the existing booked IBNR to the indicated position by class.
Compute the adjusting movement rather than an additive posting.
Done when the adjusting movement to the indicated position is computed.
verify: Existing plus movement equals the indicated position by class.
Pass when no indication is added on top of an existing balance.

steps.title: Document and approve any difference between indication and booked amount
sop: Identify any class where the booked amount will differ from the indication.
Document the reason and obtain approval before booking.
Done when every difference is documented and approved.
verify: Differences carry a reason and an approver.
Pass when no unapproved difference to the indication is booked.

steps.title: Confirm the booked IBNR agrees to the signed indication after posting
sop: Extract booked IBNR by class from the ERP general ledger after posting.
Compare to the signed indication and investigate any difference.
Done when booked IBNR is reconciled to the signed indication.
verify: Reconciliation shows booked and indicated amounts by class.
Pass when booked IBNR agrees to the signed actuarial indication.

generic.Defined scope/population: The full assumed claims position of paid, case reserves and IBNR for the reporting period.
generic.In-scope period: The reporting period and valuation date with prior period comparatives.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Treaty, underwriting year, paid, case reserve and IBNR populated on every row.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Paid, case and IBNR totals agree to the general ledger claims reserve control account.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Report saved with data cut-off, version and issue date to actuarial and finance.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Reconciling differences to the ledger logged with an explanation and an owner.
generic.Test population: Every treaty carrying claims activity or reserves at the valuation date.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Report totals agree to the ledger claims reserve control account with nil unexplained difference.
generic.Exception handling path: Unexplained differences investigated before the report is issued to finance.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Period movement split between new advices, development and payments.
generic.Evidence location: Report workbook in Microsoft Excel published to the Power BI claims workspace.

steps.title: Extract paid, case reserve and IBNR by treaty from the reinsurance administration system
sop: Run the claims position report by treaty and underwriting year at the valuation date.
Capture paid, outstanding case reserves and IBNR as separate measures.
Done when the claims position extract is produced.
verify: Extract cut-off equals the reporting valuation date.
Pass when all three measures are present by treaty and underwriting year.

steps.title: Split period movement between new advices, development and payments
sop: Decompose the movement since the prior period into the three components.
Confirm the components sum to the total movement.
Done when the movement split is produced and reconciles.
verify: Components sum to the reported period movement.
Pass when the movement is split between new advices, development and payments.

steps.title: Report large losses and catastrophe events separately with our share
sop: Identify claims above the large loss threshold and event-coded losses.
Present them in their own section with our share and event totals.
Done when large and event losses are reported separately.
verify: Large and event sections reconcile to the total position.
Pass when every event-coded loss appears in the event section.

steps.title: Reconcile the totals to the general ledger claims reserve control account
sop: Compare paid, case and IBNR totals to the ledger control account balances.
Explain and document each reconciling item.
Done when the reconciliation is complete with differences explained.
verify: Reconciliation shows report and ledger balances side by side.
Pass when paid, case and IBNR totals agree to the ledger control account.

steps.title: Publish the claims position view to Power BI
sop: Refresh the claims dataset and validate visuals against the reconciled workbook.
Publish with the valuation date shown on the report page.
Done when the published view matches the reconciled workbook.
verify: Dashboard totals equal the reconciled workbook totals.
Pass when the published view shows its valuation date.

steps.title: Issue the report to actuarial and finance within the close timetable
sop: Send the reconciled report to the actuarial and finance distribution lists.
Record the issue date against the close timetable milestone.
Done when the report is issued and the issue date recorded.
verify: Issue date compared to the close timetable deadline.
Pass when the report is issued inside the close timetable window.

generic.Defined scope/population: All assumed claims with our share reserve above the large loss threshold at the review date.
generic.In-scope period: The review period since the prior large loss review at the current valuation date.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Claim reference, cedant reserve, our share, movement and adequacy conclusion populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Reviewed claim count equals the count above the large loss threshold in the extract.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Adequacy conclusions recorded per claim with reviewer and review date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Claims where adequacy cannot be concluded logged with an action and a review date.
generic.Test population: Every claim above the large loss threshold at the valuation date.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Every claim above threshold carries a documented adequacy conclusion.
generic.Exception handling path: Agreed adjustments posted in the claims system before the reserve close.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Cedant reserve movements compared to our booked reserve for each large claim.
generic.Evidence location: Large loss review workbook in Microsoft Excel with conclusions on the claim record.

steps.title: Extract claims above the large loss threshold from the reinsurance administration system
sop: Filter claims where our share reserve exceeds the large loss threshold.
Capture cedant reserve, our share and prior review values.
Done when the large loss review population is extracted.
verify: Threshold applied is the current large loss threshold.
Pass when every claim above the threshold appears in the population.

steps.title: Compare cedant reserve movements to our booked reserve
sop: Set cedant reserve at prior and current review against our booked reserve.
Highlight claims where cedant movement is not reflected in our reserve.
Done when the comparison is complete for every large claim.
verify: Comparison shows cedant and our reserve at both dates.
Pass when no large loss reserve is unchanged where cedant reserve moved materially.

steps.title: Review loss adjuster reports and cedant reserve rationale from the claims management platform
sop: Read the latest adjuster report and cedant rationale on each large claim.
Note any change in liability, quantum or coverage position.
Done when the supporting documents are reviewed for every large claim.
verify: Review note cites the adjuster report date reviewed.
Pass when no large claim is concluded without reading current support.

steps.title: Record an adequacy conclusion per claim with the Reserving Actuary
sop: Assess whether our booked reserve is adequate given the evidence.
Record adequate, increase or decrease with the amount proposed.
Done when every large claim carries an adequacy conclusion.
verify: Conclusion states the basis and any proposed adjustment.
Pass when every claim above threshold carries a documented conclusion.

steps.title: Post agreed adjustments in the reinsurance administration system before the reserve close
sop: Apply the agreed reserve adjustments to each claim with a reason code.
Confirm the adjustments are effective before the reserve close cut-off.
Done when all agreed adjustments are posted before the close.
verify: Posted adjustments match the agreed conclusions.
Pass when no agreed adjustment is left unposted at the reserve close.

steps.title: File the large loss review workbook with the reserve review pack
sop: Save the workbook with reviewer names, review date and conclusions.
File it with the quarter reserve review pack.
Done when the workbook is filed with the review pack.
verify: Workbook shows reviewer, date and conclusion per claim.
Pass when the large loss review is retrievable from the review pack.

generic.Defined scope/population: All newly registered assumed claims requiring an initial case reserve to be set.
generic.In-scope period: From claim registration to the reserve being set within the service standard.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Cedant advised reserve, participation share, layer limit, currency and rate populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Our share reserve equals cedant advised reserve times participation, capped at the layer limit.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Basis note recorded with the cedant advice reference and the calculation used.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Reserves above handler authority logged and referred for approval before being set.
generic.Test population: Every registered claim without a case reserve at the review point.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No case reserve exceeding the layer limit or handler authority without approval.
generic.Exception handling path: Claims lacking a cedant reserve held with a nil reserve and a chase for the figure.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Reserve set in treaty currency with the exchange rate used recorded.
generic.Evidence location: Reserve record and basis note on the claim in the reinsurance administration system.

steps.title: List registered claims without a case reserve in the reinsurance administration system
sop: Filter registered claims with a nil or unset case reserve.
Capture the cedant advised reserve and advice reference for each.
Done when the reserve setting worklist is produced.
verify: Worklist covers every registered claim without a reserve.
Pass when no unreserved registered claim is omitted.

steps.title: Read the treaty participation and layer limit for each claim
sop: Retrieve the participation percentage and layer limit for the section and year.
Note the attachment point where the treaty is layered.
Done when participation and limit parameters are retrieved per claim.
verify: Parameters match the treaty record for the underwriting year.
Pass when no reserve is calculated on a participation absent from the treaty.

steps.title: Calculate our share reserve from the cedant advised reserve
sop: Apply the participation percentage to the cedant advised reserve for the layer.
Cap the result at the layer limit less any prior erosion.
Done when our share reserve is calculated and capped for every claim.
verify: Calculation reproduces from the recorded inputs.
Pass when no case reserve exceeds the layer limit.

steps.title: Set the reserve in treaty currency and record the exchange rate used
sop: Enter the reserve in the treaty currency on the claim record.
Record the exchange rate applied for reporting currency conversion.
Done when the reserve is set in treaty currency with the rate recorded.
verify: Currency and rate visible on the reserve record.
Pass when no reserve is set without its currency and rate.

steps.title: Write the basis note citing the cedant advice reference and calculation
sop: Record the cedant advice reference, advised reserve and participation applied.
Attach the note to the claim reserve record.
Done when every reserve carries a basis note.
verify: Basis note cites the cedant advice reference and the calculation.
Pass when no case reserve is set without a basis note.

steps.title: Refer reserves above handler authority for approval before setting
sop: Compare each proposed reserve to the handler authority limit.
Refer those above the limit for approval and record the approval.
Done when all above-authority reserves are approved before being set.
verify: Approval recorded with approver name and date.
Pass when no reserve above handler authority is set without approval.

generic.Defined scope/population: All cedant reserve development notices received requiring an update to our assumed reserve.
generic.In-scope period: From receipt of the development notice to the reserve update within the service standard.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Cedant claim reference, revised gross reserve, participation share and reason code populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Updated reserve equals revised cedant gross reserve times the participation share.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Notice document attached to the claim with the receipt date and updated valuation.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Notices that cannot be matched to a claim logged and queried with the cedant.
generic.Test population: Every cedant development notice received in the period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No cedant development notice left unactioned beyond the service standard.
generic.Exception handling path: Movements above the notification threshold trigger a fresh underwriter notification.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Reserve movement recorded with prior value, revised value and reason code.
generic.Evidence location: Reserve movement history on the claim in the claims management platform.

steps.title: Match the development notice to the existing claim on the cedant claim reference
sop: Search the claims management platform on the cedant claim reference from the notice.
Link the notice to the matched claim rather than opening a new record.
Done when every notice is matched to an existing claim or flagged unmatched.
verify: Match performed on the cedant reference from the notice.
Pass when no development notice opens a duplicate claim record.

steps.title: Read the revised cedant gross reserve and valuation date from the notice
sop: Capture the revised gross reserve, currency and cedant valuation date.
Compare to the previously advised figure held on the claim.
Done when the revised cedant figures are captured for every notice.
verify: Captured figures match the notice document.
Pass when no update proceeds without the revised cedant figure recorded.

steps.title: Apply the treaty participation share to the revised gross reserve
sop: Recalculate our share using the participation for the section and layer.
Cap the revised reserve at the layer limit less erosion to date.
Done when the revised our-share reserve is calculated for every notice.
verify: Recalculation uses the treaty participation on the claim.
Pass when no revised reserve exceeds the layer limit.

steps.title: Record the movement with prior value, revised value and reason code
sop: Post the reserve change on the claim with the prior and revised values.
Assign the reason code describing the driver of the movement.
Done when every reserve change carries a reason code.
verify: Movement history shows prior value, revised value and reason.
Pass when no reserve movement is posted without a reason code.

steps.title: Trigger a fresh underwriter notification where the movement breaches the threshold
sop: Compare the movement to the material movement notification threshold.
Raise the notification where the threshold is breached.
Done when threshold-breaching movements have a raised notification.
verify: Notification references the prior and revised estimate.
Pass when no threshold-breaching movement goes unnotified.

steps.title: Attach the notice document to the claim as support for the change
sop: Upload the cedant development notice to the claim record.
Confirm the attachment is linked to the reserve movement entry.
Done when every reserve change carries its supporting notice.
verify: Attachment opens and matches the recorded movement.
Pass when no reserve change lacks its supporting notice document.

generic.Defined scope/population: All calculated assumed claim payments awaiting authorization before funds release.
generic.In-scope period: From payment calculation to authorization within the contractual settlement window.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Payment amount, currency, payee, authority level and approver name populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Authorized amount equals the calculated net payable on the payment request.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Approval recorded on the claim with approver name, authority level, date and amount.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Requests declined or returned logged with the reason and the corrective action.
generic.Test population: Every payment request submitted for authorization in the period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No payment authorized by the same user who prepared the calculation.
generic.Exception handling path: Payments above the manager threshold routed for a second higher approval.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Sanctions screening result for the cedant payee confirmed clear before release.
generic.Evidence location: Authorization record on the claim in the reinsurance administration system.

steps.title: Review the payment request against the delegated authority matrix
sop: Compare the payment amount and currency to the approver authority limit.
Confirm the approver holds authority for the treaty and claim type.
Done when the authority check result is recorded on the request.
verify: Authority level recorded against the payment amount.
Pass when the approver authority covers the payment value.

steps.title: Verify coverage confirmation and reserve adequacy on the claim
sop: Check the coverage confirmation is recorded and unqualified.
Confirm the open reserve supports the payment amount.
Done when coverage and reserve checks are evidenced on the claim.
verify: Coverage confirmation and reserve position visible on the claim.
Pass when no payment is approved without an unqualified coverage confirmation.

steps.title: Confirm the sanctions screening result for the cedant payee is clear
sop: Check the screening result for the payee and the beneficiary bank.
Hold the payment where any hit remains unresolved.
Done when the screening result is confirmed clear and recorded.
verify: Screening reference and date recorded on the payment request.
Pass when no payment is released with an unresolved screening hit.

steps.title: Confirm segregation between preparer and approver
sop: Check the user who prepared the calculation against the approving user.
Reject the request where they are the same person.
Done when preparer and approver are confirmed to be different users.
verify: Preparer and approver user identities differ on the request.
Pass when no payment is authorized by its own preparer.

steps.title: Route payments above the manager threshold for a second higher approval
sop: Identify requests exceeding the manager authority threshold.

steps.title: Record the coverage confirmation on the claim in the reinsurance administration system
sop: Write the confirmation with the clauses relied on and the wording version.

Hold any request where the confirmation is missing or qualified.

sop: Despatch the confirmation to the treaty contact through the agreed channel.

generic.In-scope period: The review cycle in which the rating was set and the limit will take effect.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Tier, rating band, recommended limit, currency, current exposure and headroom populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Current aggregate exposure agrees to the system exposure report for the cedant.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Recommendation saved with data cut-off, rationale and version for the committee.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Group concentration adjustments logged with the related cedants named.
generic.Test population: Every cedant with a rating set in the current review cycle.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Recommended limit shown with current exposure and resulting headroom.
generic.Exception handling path: Limits below current exposure escalated with a run-off or reduction plan.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Recommendation, rationale and required approval level documented for the committee.
generic.Evidence location: Limit recommendation workbook in Microsoft Excel filed against the cedant record.

steps.title: Derive the recommended aggregate limit from the cedant tier and rating band
sop: Read the limit guidance for the cedant tier and rating band.
Derive the indicative aggregate limit for the cedant.

verify: Limit derives from the published tier and band guidance.

steps.title: Express the limit by treaty type and in total with the currency stated

verify: Each limit figure carries a currency.

steps.title: Extract current exposure from the reinsurance administration system

Record the exposure figure and the cut-off date.
Done when current exposure is extracted with its cut-off.
verify: Exposure figure sourced from the system report.
Pass when current aggregate exposure is sourced from the system, not keyed.

steps.title: Show headroom against the proposed limit
sop: Calculate headroom as the proposed limit less current exposure.
Flag any cedant where exposure already exceeds the proposed limit.
Done when headroom is shown for every recommendation.
verify: Headroom recomputes from limit and exposure.
Pass when recommended limit is shown with current exposure and headroom.

steps.title: Net group concentration with related cedants into the recommendation
sop: Identify related cedants within the same group.
Net the group exposure into the recommendation and state the grouping used.
Done when group concentration is netted into the recommendation.
verify: Group members named in the recommendation.

steps.title: Document the rationale and required approval level for the committee
sop: State the rationale for the recommendation and any departure from guidance.

verify: Approval level matches the authority matrix for the limit value.

generic.Defined scope/population: All cedants failing the financial strength or operational quality thresholds at review.
