generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Restriction type and effective date set on every failing cedant.
generic.Exception handling path: In-force treaty implications routed to underwriting for renewal and run-off decisions.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Block or restriction flag applied so new cessions are stopped in the system.
generic.Evidence location: Restriction flag in the reinsurance administration system with the notification thread.

steps.title: Identify cedants failing the financial strength or operational threshold

List cedants failing either threshold with the failing metric.
Done when the failing cedant list is produced.
verify: Failing list cites the metric and the threshold breached.
Pass when every failing cedant appears on the list.

steps.title: Set the restriction type for each failing cedant
sop: Choose no new business, reduced limit, collateral required or full suspension.

verify: Restriction type recorded with a rationale.

steps.title: Apply the block or restriction flag on the cedant record
sop: Set the restriction flag in the reinsurance administration system.

verify: Flag blocks new cessions from the effective date.

steps.title: List in-force treaties affected with renewal and run-off implications
sop: Extract in-force treaties for the restricted cedant with renewal dates.

Done when affected treaties are listed with their implications.
verify: Treaty list matches in-force treaties for the cedant.

steps.title: Notify underwriting and operations of the restriction and effective date
sop: Send the restriction notice to the underwriting and operations distribution lists.
Record the notification date against the cedant record.
Done when both teams are notified and the date recorded.
verify: Notification states restriction type and effective date.
Pass when no restriction takes effect without a recorded notification.

steps.title: Confirm no new cession is accepted after the effective date
sop: Monitor new cessions booked for restricted cedants after the effective date.
Investigate and reverse any cession accepted in breach.
Done when post-restriction cessions are confirmed nil or reversed.
verify: Cession report for restricted cedants shows nil after the effective date.
Pass when no new cession is accepted from a restricted cedant.

generic.Defined scope/population: All active cedants requiring a next review date and a place on the forward review calendar.

verify: Next review dates derive from last review plus frequency.

steps.title: Configure interim trigger events to force an off-cycle review
sop: Define the trigger events such as rating downgrade or late payment.
Configure the alert so a trigger creates an off-cycle review task.

verify: Trigger configuration lists the defined events.

steps.title: Publish the forward twelve month review calendar
sop: Lay out the scheduled reviews by month for the next twelve months.
Publish the calendar to the team with its version and date.

verify: Calendar covers twelve months from the publication date.

steps.title: Assign a named analyst to each scheduled review
sop: Allocate reviews to analysts balancing workload across the year.
Record the named owner against each scheduled review.

verify: Calendar shows a named owner per scheduled review.

steps.title: Queue reviews falling due ahead of their due date
sop: Create the review task in advance of the due date for the assigned analyst.

verify: Queued tasks precede their review due dates.

steps.title: Calculate the completeness metric from field population and exception rates
sop: Measure mandatory field population and the exception rate per submission.
Record the completeness metric per cedant per period.

verify: Metric derives from the validation exception data.

verify: Metric recomputes from the resubmission and correction counts.

Done when the four period trend is shown for every cedant.
verify: Trend shows all four periods, not just the latest.

sop: Combine the three metrics into the composite data quality score.
Write the score and measurement period to the cedant record for the review.

verify: Composite recomputes from the three component metrics.

sop: Archive the prior tier with its effective date range.

sop: Add the tier change to the panel change summary for the next publication.
